description:
Experience elevated living in then heart of Downtown Nashville . This beautifully designed luxurious residence blends sophistication style with modern comfort , placing you just minutes form Broadway's iconic live music , award winning restaurant ,premier entertainment and sporting events . inside , you'll find thoughtfully curated interiors featuring premium furnishing ,plush bedding ,a fully equipped gourmet kitchen ,high-speed Wi-Fi and spacious living areas designed relaxation .

The space
You can expect beautiful poolside views and a stunning glimpse of downtown Nashville right from your stay. Enjoy complimentary coffee, snacks, and refreshing drinks during your visit, adding an extra touch of comfort to your Nashville experience.

Guest access
Guests will also have access to the building’s exceptional amenities, including a refreshing pool, fully equipped fitness center, and stylish lounge area. Relax, recharge, and enjoy everything you need for a comfortable and elevated Nashville stay.

Other things to note
Our upscale Airbnb is ideally located in the heart of downtown Nashville, just a 3-minute walk from Broadway, where you’ll find the city’s legendary nightlife, live music, honky-tonks, and entertainment. Bridgestone Arena is only a 7-minute walk away, making it the perfect home base for concerts, sporting events, and exploring Music City on foot.
